newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EP demands better EU cooperation to stop terrorism.
newsitem.headline: EP demands better EU cooperation to stop terrorism.

text.p: European Union countries should increase cooperation to tackle terrorism, the European Parliament said on Thursday.
Approving a report drafted by Luxembourg Christian Democrat Viviane Reding, MEPs called for measures to improve airport security and systems for detecting explosives.
They expressed concern about inadequate protection for potential terrorist targets and the availability on the Internet of information about bomb-making.
- close monitoring of the arms trade
- compliance with the international weapons non-proliferation treaty
- classification of terrorism as an extraditable offence and swift ratification of the extradition treaty signed last September
- provisions for EU nationals to be proescuted in their home country for offences committed abroad
- a simplification of bureaucratic procedures, with central agencies to handle inquiries created in all member states.
